nodes.author: dgp1496
nodes.text: @sissyroxx @YouTube I posted this and some were saying they had just seen a documentary on it. It said that this is a seasonal thing like flu and it’s been around for years. Maybe it’s just the first we’re hearing of it in the West?

nodes.author: sissyroxx
nodes.text: @dgp1496 @YouTube I forgot to mention. The Chinese Foreign Ministry says it's not concerning and it's safe for tourists yet the Hindu times says Chinese crematoriums are overwhelmed. I don't trust either of those sources. My plan is to try to avoid it altogether if possible 💙

nodes.author: dgp1496
nodes.text: @sissyroxx @YouTube Seems to me to be be a good plan.💙

nodes.author: sissyroxx
nodes.text: @dgp1496 @YouTube #HMPV was first discovered in Netherlands in 2001. This new viral outbreak in China is not a single virus. Children are presenting with 'white lung' due to a viral soup of seasonal flu, RSV, COVID, HMPV & H1N1. Mutation risk is high & concerning.

nodes.author: dgp1496
nodes.text: @sissyroxx @YouTube A 13-year-old girl here in BC is the one and only case of avian flu we’ve had in humans. They say that the virus had mutated in two different directions. It’s concerning. She was in hospital for many weeks and they managed to save her.

nodes.author: sissyroxx
nodes.text: @dgp1496 @YouTube Thank goodness for that! America failed to respond in a timely manner and farmers are reluctant to spend the money needed for surveillance and prevention. As if that's not bad enough we may be stuck with JFKJr 🤦

nodes.author: dgp1496
nodes.text: @sissyroxx @YouTube Happy New Year, Sissy! Something to start us off from the What Now department. Good thing I still have lots of masks left from the last pandemic. Thanks for the heads up.

nodes.author: sissyroxx
nodes.text: @dgp1496 @YouTube Happy new year! I broke out the masks & hand sanitizer for my husband. My doctor says I shouldn't go out in public at all until summer even though I'm vaxed to the max 😂 Fine with me, there's no place like home 😂

nodes.author: dgp1496
nodes.text: @sissyroxx @YouTube Good idea. I think staying out of crowds in particular is worthwhile in these times of unknown consequences. Forget the rest, home is best. 😁
